description: This file defines the internal class RebalancerCompatibleRule, which implements several interfaces related to cluster rebalancing and status monitoring in Orleans. It manages cluster imbalance tolerance based on cluster size and rebalancer status, and handles silo status change notifications, reports, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: RebalancerCompatibleRule
classes.description: An internal class implementing imbalance tolerance rules, lifecycle participation, and silo status listening, which adjusts cluster rebalancing behavior based on cluster size and rebalancer status.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given imbalance is within the tolerated pairwise imbalance threshold.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles silo status change notifications and updates the pairwise imbalance accordingly.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the rule to the silo lifecycle events.

methods.name: OnReport
methods.description: Handles rebalancing reports and updates the cluster imbalance and pairwise imbalance.

methods.name: UpdatePairwiseImbalance
methods.description: Calculates and updates the pairwise imbalance threshold based on current cluster state.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Starts the rule by subscribing to silo status events and rebalancer reports.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops the rule by unsubscribing from silo status events and rebalancer reports.
